A '''clone trooper commander''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Dug Out" />

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] took part in a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Dug Out" />
